name: followups_after_save
why: 4f follow-up #3, case (d) -- the conversation does not end at the save.
Every build fixture stops at the offer, so the entire after-the-save
surface is untested: the analyst saves, then asks what it does, then asks
The specific hazard is that the save is a state transition the agent can
lose. After it, the playbook of record is the SAVED one, and turn 3's edit
must be a delta against that -- not against the pre-save draft, and not a
fragment. The widget writes the last ```yaml fence straight over the open
record, so a turn-3 answer that omits the earlier steps DELETES them; that
is the same silent-loss class HARDEN-1 gates at write time, arriving here
Turn 2 also pins the cheaper regression: having just written the playbook,
the agent must answer a question about it without asking to be handed it.
